posts.zh:
dsh-svg-motion 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH 里把任意 SVG logo 变成动效视频：`animate_svg` 工具渲染透明背景 30fps 组装动画（零件飞入或整体落位），并用 ffmpeg 合成 MP4。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dffb1e5f1b770e31218a.html
posts.en:
dsh-svg-motion is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dffb1e5f1b770e31218a.html
